blocks.content: Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
Finally, they read the page like a human:

items: Are lists used where scanning matters?
Does each section clearly communicate its purpose?

blocks.content: Good HTML reads well even without CSS.
Our latest run code of our blog has short, readable paragraphs; uses lists to make items scannable; and our sections communicate a clear purpose.
Needless to say, the blog passes the readability review.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
